stops.name: Beach
stops.quote: Welcome to Borkum: the ideal island for a day at the beach.
stops.english: Welcome to Borkum: the ideal island for a day at the beach.

stops.name: Waddensea
stops.quote: Borkum belongs to the seven East Frisian Islands and is surrounded by the Waddensea, part of the UNESCO World Heritage.
stops.english: Borkum belongs to the seven East Frisian Islands and is surrounded by the Waddensea, part of the UNESCO World Heritage.
